human_tolerance.notes: Authored judgement from the source's description of a desert-dwelling animal of arid and semi-arid bushland; no human-tolerance metric was sourced.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Wikipedia states the gemsbok has no specified breeding season; calves in a herd tend to be similar in age because females are reproductively synchronised. Gestation about 270 days, one or two offspring; pregnant females leave the herd before giving birth.

taxonomy.note: GBIF gives Oryx gazella (Linnaeus, 1758), species rank, accepted; ITIS TSN 625180 with the same author. iNaturalist taxon 42308 is an active, non-extinct species taxon with the same name (checked 2026-10-31).

external.note: GBIF usage key 5220166; iNaturalist 42308 and NCBI 9958 from Wikidata; ITIS TSN 625180.

conservation.note: Wikidata P141 least concern (Q211005); Wikipedia gives IUCN 3.1 Least Concern.

range.note: Wikipedia: 'endemic to the dry and barren regions of Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and (parts of) Zimbabwe'; Angola is omitted because the article describes it as extirpated there. Introduced populations were not evaluated, so no introduced list is given.

traits.limb_count.note: Four-legged ungulate; the limb convention counts walking limbs.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Walk and gallop only. Gallop is supported by the running-speed sentence. Trot is not stated in the fetched article, so it is not declared.

traits.thermoregulation.note: Endotherm: a mammal. Desert-dwelling is stated in Wikipedia; body temperature regulation is general mammalian biology.

traits.skin.note: Fur: mammal; coat colour is described in Wikipedia, texture is general mammalian biology.

traits.mass_kg.note: Wikipedia: males 180-240 kg (midpoint 210), females 100-210 kg (midpoint 155); typical adult set to the mean of the two sex midpoints, 182.5 kg. This averaging is an authored combination, not a published statistic.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Lowest female to highest male: 100-240 kg, from the Wikipedia text.

traits.length_m.note: Wikipedia: 'The body length can vary from 190 to 240 cm'; midpoint 215 cm. Wikipedia gives tail length separately (45-90 cm), so the schema's nose-to-tail length may be larger; this is not reconciled.

traits.shoulder_height_m.note: Wikipedia: 'They stand about 1.2 m (4 ft) at the shoulder.'

traits.speed_ms.note: Wikipedia: 'They can reach running speeds of up to 60 km/h (37 mph)'. Converted to 16.7 m/s, a maximum, not a typical speed.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Typical wild lifespan: ADW Lifespan/Longevity section, 'The average life span is approximately 18 years in the wild'. Sourced from a non-commercial (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) page; no permissive source found. Captive or maximum values are not used.

traits.diet.note: Wikipedia: 'generally a grazer but changes to browsing during the dry season or when grass is sparse'. The 0.8/0.2 split is an authored estimate of that statement, not a measured proportion.

traits.social.note: Wikipedia: 'Gemsbok live in herds of about 10-40 animals'.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Wikipedia: 'Gemsbok are mostly crepuscular in nature.' The fetched text does not describe night activity or daytime resting.

traits.defense.note: Flight is the main response. Wikipedia describes horns used against rival males. Defence category is authored.

traits.wariness.note: Authored judgement (0.7) for a large herd-living antelope that flees from approach; no source sentence gives a flight distance.

habitat.use.note: Wikipedia: arid and semi-arid bushland, mainly ground-living; ground share set to 1.0 as an authored simplification.

habitat.resources.note: Graze as main food and browse in droughts follow Wikipedia; the shelter tag and weights are authored simplifications.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Authored judgement: an Avoider of natural arid habitat. No human-tolerance metric is sourced.

seasonal.note: Year-round: Wikipedia states no specified breeding season, with gestation about 270 days. The phase is therefore the full year rather than a seasonal window.

activity.NA.note: Generated by tools/fetch_activity.py. See the PR for the query, counts and usable flags.

behavior.note: Shared fsm-ground-forager-v1 program with food_tag overridden to graze (graze is the main food per Wikipedia). Other params use the program defaults; flee and calm distances are not sourced for this animal.

look.note: Authored look. Long straight horns in both sexes, averaging 85 cm, and black tail, neck stripe and white leg socks are from Wikipedia. Proportions and palette are authored.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Authored simplification: shelter (shade and rest) mapped to the generic shelter tag; the sources do not name a shelter type.

traits.flight.note: Non-flying ungulate; general mammalian biology, not stated in the cited sources.

traits.metamorphosis.note: Mammal without metamorphosis; general biology, not stated in the cited sources.

traits.perching.note: Non-perching ungulate; general biology, not stated in the cited sources.

traits.respiration.note: Mammal breathing with lungs; general biology, not stated in the cited sources.

traits.size_class.note: Large: schema rule for mass 50 kg or more, applied to the derived mass_kg of 182.5.
